build_equivariant_layer_norm: build an EquivariantLayerNormArray module to normalize equivariant features of shape N, sphere_basis, C per degree L
build_layer_norm_spherical_harmonics: build an EquivariantLayerNormArraySphericalHarmonics module to normalize L=0 separately and all L>0 m components together
build_rms_norm_spherical_harmonics_v2: build an EquivariantRMSNormArraySphericalHarmonicsV2 module to RMS normalize all degrees with optional centering and degree balancing
build_degree_layer_scale: build an EquivariantDegreeLayerScale module to scale equivariant features by degree with learnable affine weights
create_normalization_layer_factory: create a normalization layer using get_normalization_layer with norm_type, lmax, and num_channels parameters
